    parsed = urlsplit(reference)\
    if external:\
        # For external resources, use the URL as-is\
        return transport.fetch(reference, credentials=session.cookie)\
    if parsed.scheme or parsed.netloc:\
        raise ValueError("absolute resource URLs require external=True")\
\
    url = urljoin(session.origin, reference)\
    return transport.fetch(url, credentials=session.cookie)/' ./app/service.py

from app.models import Session
from app.dependencies import Transport
from app.service import fetch_resource

# Test 1: Relative URL with default external=False
session = Session('https://app.example/base/', 'sid=abc')
transport = Transport()
result = fetch_resource('images/logo.png', session, transport)
print('Relative URL test:', result.url)

# Test 2: Absolute URL with external=True  
result = fetch_resource('https://cdn.example/assets/logo.png', session, transport, external=True)
print('External URL test:', result.url)

# Test 3: Absolute URL with external=False should fail
try:
    fetch_resource('https://cdn.example/assets/logo.png', session, transport, external=False)
    print('ERROR: Should have failed')
except ValueError as e:
    print('Absolute URL without external=True correctly failed:', str(e))
